day_shape: 80 items: IDF strike on Hamas Gaza commander Izz al-Din al-Haddad with 13 bombs, NYT report of US-Israel preparing renewed strikes on Iran next week, US arrest of Kataib Hezbollah commander, OFAC SDN designation, UK ECOSOC statement on Hormuz, and heavy Khamenei Ferdowsi/Persian-language messaging.

threads.label: Strike on Hamas Gaza commander Haddad
threads.summary: The IDF struck a residential building in Gaza City's Rimal neighbourhood targeting Hamas Gaza commander Izz al-Din al-Haddad, described as the last surviving October 7 architect. Three IAF jets dropped 13 bombs after roughly ten days of surveillance, with initial indications of a successful kill, according to a senior Israeli security official.

threads.label: Hezbollah-IDF exchanges across Lebanon border
threads.summary: IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for Tyre and multiple south Lebanon villages and launched a wave of airstrikes on Hezbollah infrastructure in the Tyre area. Hezbollah fired drones, rockets and mortars, with impacts reported in Kiryat Shmona and Metula and sirens triggered near Mount Meron and the Galilee Panhandle.

threads.label: US-Iran trajectory: renewed strikes report, stalled talks
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post, citing a New York Times report quoting two Middle East officials, said the US and Israel are preparing joint attacks on Iran to resume as soon as next week. Trump said he would accept a 20-year Iranian nuclear suspension with a 'real' commitment, while talks are described as stalled and Space Force is reportedly monitoring enriched-uranium sites.

threads.label: Kataib Hezbollah arrest and OFAC action
threads.summary: The US Department of Justice announced the arrest and transfer to the United States of senior Kataib Hezbollah figure Mohammad Baqir Saad Dawood al-Saadi, charged with material support for Iranian-backed groups and plotting attacks on Jewish targets. OFAC separately published a Specially Designated Nationals listing, and the FBI advertised a $200,000 reward for former US Air Force counterintelligence specialist Monica Witt over Iran-related espionage.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz, oil flows, blockade
threads.summary: UK Ambassador Helen King delivered a statement at the UN ECOSOC on the Strait of Hormuz crisis, while CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 75 commercial vessels and disabled four enforcing a maritime blockade against Iran. The UAE is accelerating an oil pipeline to bypass Hormuz, TankerTrackers attributed an Iranian oil flow drop to a spill, and IRIB carried a Rashataday piece claiming Iran has set up new monitoring of Hormuz traffic.

threads.label: UAE-Israel alignment, Gulf split
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir made a secret wartime visit to the UAE with a US delegation during Operation Roaring Lion, and that the UAE pressed Saudi Arabia, Qatar and other Gulf states to coordinate strikes on Iran but was refused. The UAE publicly rejected what it called Iranian attempts to justify terror after Tehran alleged an Emirati role in the war.

threads.label: Khamenei Ferdowsi/Persian-language messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a message marking Persian Language Preservation Day and the commemoration of Ferdowsi, framing the recent war as a 'glorious victory' and urging cultural activists to consolidate it. Defa Press and IRIB amplified the theme with items on a Tehran University gathering and the President's letter to the Pope on Trump's 'unlawful positions'.

events.title_en: Message of the leader of the Islamic Revolution on the occasion of Persian language preservation day and the commemoration of sage Abul Qasim Ferdowsi. In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate. Persian language besides being a tool of speech and writing forms the framework of understanding and the thread of connection of thought and the identity boundaries of Iranians. Persian language and literature is one of the greatest capacities for promoting the rich culture and civilisation of Islamic Iran on a global scale; and the recommendation of our wise and martyred leader, may his station be elevated, for strengthening the Persian language is the torch lighting the path for 'Iranian-Islamic civilisation' to prevail. The noble Iranian people in the third sacred defence also, as in the two previous imposed wars, proved that Ferdowsi's legendary tales are the reality of their lives and heroic character.

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them.
